0022600165.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, who are 6-0 and lead the Southwest and the West, host the New Orleans Pelicans in their seventh game of the season, with the Grizzlies riding a six-game winning streak and the Pelicans sitting 2-4 and fifth in the Southwest, 4 games back, on a two-game win streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting a 114-106 Pelicans win in New Orleans on January 30, 2026. Grizzlies forwards Quinten Post and Scotty Pippen Jr. are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, with Post out with an ankle injury and Pippen with back soreness, while the Pelicans will be without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), all listed as out.
